diff --git a/django/utils/decorators.py b/django/utils/decorators.py
index 5c9a5d01c7..ea2d687e2f 100644
--- a/django/utils/decorators.py
+++ b/django/utils/decorators.py
@@ -17,6 +17,10 @@ def _update_method_wrapper(_wrapper, decorator):
     def dummy(*args, **kwargs):
         pass
     update_wrapper(_wrapper, dummy)
+    # If the decorator is a partial object, it doesn't have __name__ etc.
+    # Copy attributes from the original function if available.
+    if hasattr(decorator, 'func'):
+        update_wrapper(_wrapper, decorator.func)
 
 
 def _multi_decorate(decorators, method):

diff --git a/django/utils/decorators.py b/django/utils/decorators.py
index 5c9a5d01c7..4a98c292f4 100644
--- a/django/utils/decorators.py
+++ b/django/utils/decorators.py
@@ -17,6 +17,18 @@ def _update_method_wrapper(_wrapper, decorator):
     def dummy(*args, **kwargs):
         pass
     update_wrapper(_wrapper, dummy)
+    # Preserve any attributes that the decorator adds to the function it
+    # decorates, even if the decorator receives a partial object.
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__name__'):
+        _wrapper.__name__ = decorator.__name__
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__module__'):
+        _wrapper.__module__ = decorator.__module__
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__doc__'):
+        _wrapper.__doc__ = decorator.__doc__
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__qualname__'):
+        _wrapper.__qualname__ = decorator.__qualname__
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__annotations__'):
+        _wrapper.__annotations__ = decorator.__annotations__
 
 
 def _multi_decorate(decorators, method):
